name: Blinded
summary: Can't see; automatically fails sight checks; attack rolls against it have advantage, its attacks have disadvantage.

name: Charmed
summary: Can't attack the charmer or target it with harmful effects; the charmer has advantage on social checks against it.

name: Deafened
summary: Can't hear; automatically fails hearing checks.

name: Exhaustion
summary: 2024: each level gives -2 to d20 tests and -5 ft. speed; level 6 is death. Long rest removes one level.

name: Frightened
summary: Disadvantage on ability checks and attacks while the source is in sight; can't willingly move closer to it.

name: Grappled
summary: Speed 0; disadvantage on attacks against anyone except the grappler; escape with a Strength or Dexterity save against the grappler's DC.

name: Incapacitated
summary: Can't take actions, bonus actions, or reactions; concentration breaks; 2024: speed 0 and disadvantage on initiative.

name: Invisible
summary: Can't be seen without magic or special sense; advantage on initiative (2024); attacks against it have disadvantage, its attacks have advantage.

name: Paralyzed
summary: Incapacitated, can't move or speak, auto-fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks against it have advantage and hits within 5 ft. are critical.

name: Petrified
summary: Turned to stone; Incapacitated, weight ×10, resistance to all damage, immune to poison and disease.

name: Poisoned
summary: Disadvantage on attack rolls and ability checks.

name: Prone
summary: Can only crawl; disadvantage on attacks; melee attacks within 5 ft. against it have advantage, ranged attacks have disadvantage. Standing costs half movement.

name: Restrained
summary: Speed 0; attacks against it have advantage, its attacks have disadvantage; disadvantage on Dexterity saves.

name: Stunned
summary: Incapacitated, can only speak falteringly, auto-fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks against it have advantage.

name: Unconscious
summary: Incapacitated, unaware, drops what it holds and falls prone; auto-fails Strength and Dexterity saves; attacks have advantage and hits within 5 ft. are critical.
